channel.title: Shareholder returns: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New shareholder returns filings from Korean small and mid caps.

item.title: Daesung Private Equity decided to sign a KRW 1.0bn trust contract with KB Securities to acquire treasury shares for price stabilization.
NPK decides to terminate its KRW 1.0bn treasury share acquisition trust with Samsung Securities early, as the buyback is complete.
GlobalStandardTechnologyCo decided to terminate its KRW 5.0bn treasury share trust early with Daishin Securities after completing the buyback.
Cheil Worldwide decided to buy back 3,291,278 common shares for KRW 60.0bn on-market from November 25, 2026 to January 29, 2027.
Access Bio's board approved a KRW 10bn trust contract with Korea Investment & Securities to acquire treasury shares for price stabilization and shareholder value.
Abko's board decided on 24 Nov 2026 to sign a KRW 3.0bn trust contract with KB Securities to buy treasury shares.
KnJ's board decided on 24 Nov 2026 to terminate its KRW 3.0bn treasury share trust with Mirae Asset Securities after completing purchases.
Aniplus board decides to sign a KRW 1.0bn treasury share acquisition trust agreement with Samsung Securities on November 24, 2026.
Siliconii terminated its KRW 5.0bn treasury share trust with Samsung Securities early on 13 Nov 2026 after completing its buyback.
